summary: Release 2.7 revision 8 is READY_TO_FREEZE. GLM 5.3 session ses_fc19227f9ffeUa2pNWOjrQ5EWL and Grok 4.6 xhigh session 01a03e6d-d6a6-7791-8105-e0fad0253f34 independently reproduced all revision 6 and 7 blockers and verified that revision 8 owns the complete fixes, direct regression tests and deterministic evidence. The final reviewedPlanHash binds the same accepted semantics plus FROZEN status and declared audit/review inventory. No open Medium, High or Critical finding remains.

dimensions.rationale: Eight requirements map one-to-one to eight acceptance criteria and evidence routes, including the full blocking-severity contract.
All 81 implementation paths are unique, single-owned and sequenced WS27-01 through WS27-03; publication pins and direct gate tests are included.
The plan requires per-severity gate mutations, round and disposition mutations, participation matrices, statistical boundary fixtures, full-suite validation and exact-candidate release gates.
Reviewer text remains non-executable, open required findings cannot be accepted through agreement or budget exhaustion, and participation composes existing verdict and external-job authority.
The release extends existing Review Mesh, finding-check, external-job, evidence and metrics seams without a second workflow, verdict, storage, statistical or execution subsystem.
The tracked Release 2.6 baseline preserves measured, time-window and unavailable semantics and cannot justify a one-sample percentage target.
Round limits, immutable dispositions, current-lineage unique samples and successful PASS-or-FAIL reviewer jobs have deterministic fail-closed acceptance behavior.

findings.message: Two display-only severity order tables omit CRITICAL but do not influence acceptance.
findings.requiredAction: Prefer the canonical severity order when touching an already owned path; otherwise retain as a documented non-gate residual risk.

findings.message: EV27-SEVERITY originally did not name the host test for its incomplete-literal source scan.
findings.requiredAction: Host the source scan in the already owned tests/contracts/test_review_verdict.py module.

findings.message: Traversal-shaped route identifiers are inert because routes are equality-compared and never resolved as paths.
findings.requiredAction: Consider a stable identifier grammar while implementing the already required traversal mutation tests.

findings.message: Revision 7 owned only three of the reachable acceptance filters that omitted CRITICAL.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 8 owns all current incomplete filters and their direct tests under AC27-SEVERITY.

findings.message: Revision 7 incorrectly excluded complete blocking-eligible SUCCEEDED jobs whose job verdict was FAIL.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 8 counts SUCCEEDED PASS or FAIL jobs when a valid review verdict is bound; incomplete and no-final-verdict results remain non-participating.
